ai.seo_question: Who was the recipient of Imam Ali's letter in this section of Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a specific administrative directive from Imam Ali (peace be upon him) to his provincial governors, reflecting the practical application of his governance model during the early Caliphate. It highlights the Shi'a emphasis on justice, accountability, and the moral responsibilities of leaders in managing public affairs, as compiled by Sharif al-Radi in Nahj al-Balagha.
